title: Bound purchase returns by explicit approved receipt capacity
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Existing authorized purchase return users linking SourceStockInId must resolve a live approved procurement receipt, same supplier and authoritative warehouse/product/base-unit evidence at create/update/submit/approve. Reuse live current user, actual menu and authoritative upstream customer scope where applicable; reject mismatched/nonexistent/deleted/cancelled source and conflicting snapshots. Genuinely null legacy returns stay explicit within existing authorization; never infer source from number or widen permissions.

Serialize linked receipt and return documents before approval and reversal; cumulative effective approved linked returns per product cannot exceed received base quantities. Aggregate duplicate product lines, reject invalid source/corrupt active quantity or units without inventory or financial writes. Keep existing sourced valuation and currency boundaries; post all lines/status/auditable ledger atomically, rollback later-line failures and release capacity only through explicit unaudit. Real two-connection tests invoke actual controller/service business operations for competing returns and source transitions, never reimplement posting in the test.
